## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I can contribute this work under AGPL-3.0-only and have identified any third-party material.
- [ ] I preserved relevant licenses and attribution.
- [ ] I used fictional data and included no credentials or personal records.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check:fast` and relevant focused tests.
